content = note_resp['content']
lines = content.splitlines()
movies=[]
current_title=None
current_director=None
for line in lines:
    line=line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    if line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- director:'):
        current_director = line.replace('- director:','').strip()
    elif not line.startswith('-'):
        # new title
        current_title = line
        current_director = None
    # when we have a title and director, we can store when director line occurs
    if current_title and current_director:
        movies.append((current_title, current_director))
        current_title=None
        current_director=None

print('movies found', len(movies))
print(movies)
# filter Peter Jackson
pj = [title for title, director in movies if director == 'Peter Jackson']
print('Peter Jackson', pj)
print('comma', ', '.join(pj))
